model.name: Moss Image 5B Edit HQ v4
model.description: Edit a reference image with text using the community MOSS Image Edit HQ v4 adapter on SFT. It targets localized changes and preservation of surrounding details, using the same 5B base with a larger editing adapter than Edit SFT. Up to four references are accepted, but multi-image compositing is limited and unchanged pixels are not guaranteed.

prompt: Change only the jacket to dark blue. Preserve the person's face, hair, pose, background and lighting.
